messages:
alex: Quick sync 1: proto attached. Need a call on: streaming display (floating token pill vs right rail), stop+regen affordance, token visibility on mobile, and where prompt library lives. Link: https://figma.com/file/zzzz/playground-stream-proto

nora: Saw the flows. Floating pill = lightweight and keeps convo feel. Rail = better for heavy telemetry. Also thinking about discoverability for prompt library.

liam: Floating pill concept: small rounded pill anchored to the top-left of the active message. On hover/focus it expands into a compact breakdown: "Prompt: 120 | Output: 45 | Total: 165". Tap/click opens full token panel in footer.

kevin: Concern: on narrow viewports the pill can overlap actions (stop/regenerate). For mobile we should collapse tokens into the composer footer (icon-only) and reveal full meter when composer expanded.

nora: Accessibility notes up front:
- streaming text needs an aria-live="polite" container with role="log" for partial reads.
- avoid moving focus during stream updates; only announce final result unless user explicitly focuses the message.
- any interactive control must have visible focus and accessible name.

alex: Stop/regenerate options: two patterns: (1) Two separate buttons — Stop (while streaming) + Regenerate (after finish). (2) Single interrupt toggle that changes label/state. Which do people prefer?

liam: Two buttons. Separate affordances are clearer and we can give explicit aria-labels: "Stop generation" / "Regenerate response". Single toggle hides semantics and complicates keyboard discoverability.

kevin: +1 for separate. Implementation: Stop sends immediate cancel to stream endpoint, returns partial tokens; Regenerate fires a fresh generation with same prompt. Regen should be disabled during streaming (aria-disabled) and enable once stream completes.

ux-bot: infra-bot: backend event plan: `generation.interrupt` with fields `reason:user` | `reason:timeout` and `tokens_so_far`. Sample: `{event:"generation.interrupt",reason:"user",tokens:82,thread:"${thread_ts}"}`

nora: Microcopy suggestions:
- Token label: "Tokens" (short) with tooltip "Prompt + output breakdown".
- Stop tooltip: "Stop generation — Esc".
- Regenerate tooltip: "Regenerate response".
- Prompt library: call it "Prompt Dock" in UI to emphasize quick insert.

liam: Keyboard shortcuts: Esc = stop, Shift+Enter (or Ctrl+Enter) = regenerate? Need to avoid conflicting with existing editor shortcuts. Also add a keyboard shortcut help overlay (?).

kevin: Suggestion: Esc to stop, Ctrl+Shift+R to regenerate (avoids collisions). We'll document in shortcuts page.

alex: Animation/UX: stream should append per chunk. Use subtle caret-like fade rather than sliding blocks to avoid layout shift. Honor `prefers-reduced-motion`. Also expose a user setting to "Show streaming animation".

nora: A11y nit: if we append chunks, avoid reflow that changes reading order for AT. Keep updates within the same DOM node and update textContent so SR sees it as one changing node.

liam: CSS draft for floating pill (desktop only):
```css
.floating-token-pill{
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  left: 12px;
  background: #111827;
  color: #F9FAFB;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
@media (max-width: 720px){
  .floating-token-pill{display:none}
  .composer-token-icon{display:inline-block}
}
```

kevin: Contrast check: `#111827` on `#F9FAFB` is fine in dark->light modes but test in dark mode variants. Use semibold for numbers to improve legibility at 12px.

alex: Prompt library placement: proposal to move from modal to a left-side dock (Prompt Dock) with drag-to-insert and quick-search. Rationale: reduces modal interruptions and makes discovery easier. Thoughts?

nora: Dock is great for power users. For new users, include a small "Discover prompts" inline card in composer that links to the dock. Also ensure dock is keyboard reachable (aria role="complementary" with heading).

liam: Implementation note: drag-to-insert should support keyboard equivalent (select prompt then "Insert into composer" button). Must not be drag-only.

kevin: Telemetry: tag inserts with `prompt_source`: dock | quick_card | api. Track `prompt_id` and model tokens estimate.

ux-bot: analytics-bot: captured: `prompt.insert` {source: "dock", id: "xxx", est_tokens: 52} and `generation.start` {model: "redwood-embed-1", prompt_tokens:120}%

alex: Decisions coming out of this thread:
- Desktop: floating token pill anchored on message. Mobile: composer footer token icon.
- Stop and Regenerate are separate buttons. Stop cancels server stream immediately; Regenerate disabled during streaming.
- Prompt library becomes left-side "Prompt Dock"; also a discoverable inline quick-card.
- Keyboard: Esc = stop, Ctrl+Shift+R = regenerate (doc to be added).
- A11y: use aria-live polite + single-node updates, explicit aria-labels, visible focus states, test NVDA/VoiceOver.

actions: alex -> write spec + copy; nora -> accessibility checklist + SR passes; liam -> updated figma and CSS states; kevin -> telemetry + shortcut mapping; ux-bot -> stub analytics events.

nora: I'll leave comments on the figma and add ARIA snippets.

liam: I'll hand off polished frames by EOD tomorrow.

kevin: I'll add telemetry schema to the infra doc.

alex: Thanks team. We'll ship floating pill to beta and iterate based on real usage. End thread.
